name: Sollfege Smart Electronics Ltd
lm_rationale: Chittorgarh's 2026 SME lead-manager tracker shows Finshore Management Services with 5 issues managed (₹187.37 Cr), 4 positive listings (80%) and 1 negative (20%), but only a +3.76% average listing-day gain — a high positive-listing rate with a thin average gain, below the ≥5% bar for a clean 'Solid' rating.
valuation_text: 15.16x pre-issue / ~25.10x post-issue P/E (Prospectus FY26 basis); no listed peer disclosed
net_proceeds: ₹8.54 Cr to open 12 new company-operated showrooms, ₹9.67 Cr for working capital, ₹1.80 Cr for General Corporate Purposes (₹20.02 Cr net proceeds, on ₹21.78 Cr gross less ₹1.76 Cr issue expenses).
key_risks: Revenue is heavily West Bengal-concentrated (90.72% of FY26 revenue from the West Bengal store). Customer concentration is rising: top 10 customers were 67.32% of FY26 revenue, up from 57.68% in FY25. The company had negative operating cash flow in FY24 (-₹43.12 lakh) and FY26 (-₹65.66 lakh), driven by rising inventory. Promoters have given personal guarantees on company borrowings. Promoter Umesh Kumar Agarwal's average cost of acquisition is ₹5.89/share versus the ₹55 issue price (9.3x). There was a belated FLA/ODI filing with RBI (submitted Aug 2025) for a since-deregistered Hong Kong subsidiary, Denn Global Ltd, a technical FEMA non-compliance. Risk factors also flag low customer repeat-purchase rates and reliance on a single godown for inventory.
market_moat: Premium audio-video, home-automation and smart-living electronics retailer/integrator operating an 'experience-first' showroom model (Kolkata, Gurgaon, Bhubaneswar) with relationships to global electronics brands, national distributors, architects, interior designers and builders. Serves both B2C retail and B2B/project-based commercial and institutional customers.
management: Sole promoter Umesh Kumar Agarwal; 99.90% pre-issue promoter holding (99.97% incl. promoter group) drops to 60.34% post-issue (60.38% incl. group).
prose_business: Sollfege Smart Electronics distributes and integrates premium audio, video, home-automation, lighting/climate control and lifestyle electronics through experience-centre showrooms designed to mimic real living environments, letting customers test products before buying, alongside project work with architects and interior designers.
highlight_dev: The company allotted a 3:1 bonus issue (45,30,000 shares) on 29 Jul 2025, which the Prospectus's Basis for Issue Price restates with retrospective effect across FY24-FY26 EPS/NAV figures.
sector_outlook: Not separately quantified with third-party industry data in the sections reviewed.
peer_sentence: The Prospectus states explicitly: 'We believe that none of the listed companies in India offer products or services across the various business segments in which we operate. Hence a strict comparison is not possible' — no listed peer disclosed for comparison.
verdict_reason: Growth has slowed sharply (PAT +3.05% in FY26 vs +20.87% in FY25), returns are declining (RoNW 46.90%→22.56%→18.86% over FY24-FY26) even as leverage is roughly flat, and there is no listed peer to benchmark the fixed ₹55 price against
why: Total income growth slowed to 4.43% in FY26 (from 7.28% in FY25 and 55.72% in FY24) and PAT growth slowed to 3.05% (from 20.87% in FY25), while EBITDA margin kept improving (9.35%→15.43%→18.02%) even as PAT margin held flat near 9.9%. RoNW has fallen steadily from 46.90% (FY24) to 22.56% (FY25) to 18.86% (FY26) as the equity base grew from the 2025 bonus issue and IPO-related capital raise, and D/E sits at 0.60 after dipping to 0.47 in FY25. On the Prospectus's own FY26 restated basis the fixed ₹55 issue price is 15.16x pre-issue P/E and about 25.10x post-issue P/E (chittorgarh's page shows a lower pre-issue EPS/higher P/E because it annualises interim Sep-30-2025 earnings rather than the full FY26 restated figures used here). The Prospectus states outright that no listed peer is comparable, so this multiple cannot be benchmarked against a disclosed industry P/E. Net proceeds are growth-led: ₹8.54 Cr for 12 new showrooms and ₹9.67 Cr for working capital. Lead manager Finshore's 2026 SME record is 80% positive listings but only a +3.76% average gain. No GMP was reported as of 26 Sep 2026 (issue opens 30 Sep).
suggestion: Watch; growth and returns are both decelerating and there is no disclosed peer to sanity-check the fixed price, though fund use is clean and growth-led
documents: drhp-cache/sollfege-smart-electronics-prospectus.pdf (Prospectus dated 24 Sep 2026, fixed price ₹55, 39,60,000 fresh shares, BSE SME — matches chittorgarh's live cohort)
drhp-cache/sollfege-smart-electronics-drhp.pdf (Draft Prospectus dated 23 Apr 2026, used only to cross-check KPI continuity, not as the pricing source)
discrepancies: Chittorgarh's KPI table shows figures 'as of Sep 30, 2025' alongside 'Mar 31, 2025' — this is the stale interim 7-month period from the DRHP (dated 23 Apr 2026), not the full FY26 restated figures in the final Prospectus (dated 24 Sep 2026). This card uses the Prospectus's FY26 (31 Mar 2026) full-year figures throughout instead

Chittorgarh's IPO Valuation table (EPS pre ₹3.52 / post ₹2.10, P/E pre 15.63x / post 26.19x) is explicitly disclosed by chittorgarh itself as using 'annualized FY earnings of September 30, 2025' — i.e. an annualised partial-year figure, not an RHP-disclosed annual figure. This card instead uses the Prospectus's own Basis-for-Issue-Price FY26 restated EPS (₹3.63, post-bonus) for pre-issue P/E (15.16x, matching the Prospectus's own stated ratio) and computes post-issue P/E as issue price ÷ (FY26 PAT ÷ post-issue shares) = 55 / (219.13L/100L) = 25.10x

The Prospectus's Basis for Issue Price shows two parallel EPS series for the same years — 'With Retrospective Effect of Bonus' (₹4.35/₹3.52/₹3.63 for FY24/25/26) and 'As per Restated (Book Value)' (₹17.42/₹18.92/₹3.63) — because the FY26 3:1 bonus issue mechanically explains most of the FY24-FY25 gap between the two series but not why FY26 collapses to the same low figure in both; both are reported here as sourced, and FY26's post-bonus EPS of ₹3.63 is used consistently since it is FY26's ONLY value in both series

NAV per share also has two RHP series for FY25: ₹15.61 (bonus-retrospective) vs ₹62.43 (as reported book value); this card uses the bonus-retrospective FY26 NAV of ₹19.24 (single reported value for FY26, no bifurcation) plus the Prospectus's own directly-disclosed post-issue NAV of ₹33.40

P/BV is presented as two figures (2.86x pre-issue on FY26 NAV of ₹19.24; 1.65x post-issue on the Prospectus's own disclosed post-issue NAV of ₹33.40) rather than one figure, since the reference card format's single P/BV field doesn't fit a fixed-price issue with both pre- and post-issue NAV disclosed
